about: layouts: CQ9-4 / F114 R28E exact-integer reference curves and both graduated layouts, checked by layout-v2.test.ts and launch_shape.py --check-small-raises. Amounts are decimal strings. WBTC-mainnet uses listing 10's unchanged 15,100,000 sats; WBTC-rehearsal uses one tenth of it.

M2-01: m2 raw-unit oracle examples consume the M2-00 freeze, independently of spec admission. Conformance-v2.test.ts checks both floors, U+V, source splits and weekly snapshots. No old proposed BC id is allocated. Shared spec vectors now identify their live M2 subjects; those tags prove admission only.
